agentdojo_proxy_queue.safety_note: The proxy records job IDs and requests cancellation on timeout or poll failure; this is not a provider-enforced spending cap.

sampling.reproducibility_note: Record the serialized request and response metadata for every AgentDojo episode; endpoint defaults are not per-request controls.

scope_note: The endpoint is a serverless queue. The documented /openai/v1 route is recorded but not yet validated by a tool-bearing completion for this endpoint; the standalone trace runner retains the successful /runsync input.route=/v1/chat/completions fallback, while the AgentDojo proxy submits /run jobs and polls/cancels by ID. Proposed tools execute only inside the pinned AgentDojo sandbox; no external side effects are claimed.
cost_guard: No new endpoint was created for the paired smoke. Live invocation is billable at the observed $2.72/GPU-hour; health and worker logs are recorded before each run.
